days.summary: Forage-heavy opener. Harvest starter parsnips, gather wood, run a full town-to-beach forage loop, then return to plant parsnips and clear the south exit before bed.
expectedOutcomes: One of each spring forageable reserved for Wild Seeds

tasks.title: Harvest the starter parsnips
tasks.instructions: Wake at 6 AM and pick every parsnip on the farm. These are the 15 starter crops Lewis left behind.

tasks.title: Clear the land around the big stump
tasks.instructions: Chop weeds, small logs, and stones in the square around the large stump near spawn. This opens the space you'll plant parsnips in tonight.

tasks.title: Gather ~50 wood
tasks.instructions: Chop trees while clearing. Aim for roughly 50 wood so you can craft a chest and still have a reserve for tomorrow.

tasks.title: Craft a chest and stash everything but tools
tasks.instructions: Open the craft menu, make one chest (50 wood), drop it near the house. Store parsnips, seeds, and junk — keep only the scythe, hoe, axe, pickaxe, watering can, and a little food.

tasks.title: Run the full forage loop
tasks.instructions: Exit the farm via the top-left gate. Forage the path up, around Robin's house, and on toward Cindersnap Forest — skip the river. Reach Robin's by ~8:50 AM. Then: forage around the Community Center (start with the weeds to its left), swing through the Bus Stop, return and whack CC weeds top-right going down, head to Marnie's ranch, loop the forest starting top-right going anticlockwise, come back past Haley's, finish at the beach. Carry scythe (weeds) and hoe (artifact spots).

tasks.title: Dig artifact spots — donate to Gunther if found
tasks.instructions: Worm tiles (small wiggling Xs) give artifacts when hoed. If you find one before 4 PM, walk it to the Museum and donate — Gunther pays 250g per first donation, which funds extra parsnip seeds at Pierre's before close.

tasks.title: Reserve one of each forageable
tasks.instructions: Before heading home, set aside one Wild Horseradish, one Daffodil, one Leek, and one Dandelion. Ten of these craft into Spring Seeds at Foraging level 1 — ~70g more value than selling them raw. The same four also cover the Spring Foraging Bundle once the Community Center opens.

bundleContext.note: Requires 1 Wild Horseradish, 1 Daffodil, 1 Leek, 1 Dandelion. Stash one of each in a chest now — the CC unlocks later this season.

tasks.title: Return to farm and plant parsnips
tasks.instructions: Back at the farm by 6 PM. Plant as many of the harvested parsnip seeds as you can on the cleared ground. Eat a forageable for energy if needed — just don't burn through everything.

tasks.title: Clear the southern farm exit
tasks.instructions: Use whatever energy is left to clear the path leading off the southern edge of the farm. You'll want it open for tomorrow's beach run.

tasks.title: Do not use the shipping bin tonight
tasks.instructions: Keep every forageable, parsnip, and artifact — they're worth more as seeds, gifts, and donations than as raw shipping. Expect to hit Foraging level 1 when you sleep.
